newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SUPREMA BUYS VILNIAUS VINGIS SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: SUPREMA BUYS VILNIAUS VINGIS SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Lithuanian brokerage Suprema said on Wednesday it had bought the 2.764 million share issue of Vilniaus Vingis for 16 million litas and now owns 30.3 percent of the company.
Suprema finalised the deal on Tuesday, Suprema financial analyst Paulius Dumshe told Reuters.
"None of the old shareholders executed their preemptive rights (to buy new shares)," Dumshe said.
The 30-day period of preemptive rights for Vilniaus Vingis shareholders to buy into the new issue ended last week.
Suprema said last month it was mulling an issue of global depository receipts (GDRs) with Vilniaus Vingis shares but still has not decided, Dumshe said.
"Within the next three months we will make the decision about GDRs and the future, what we will do and how long we will hold this stake," Dumshe said.
Vilniaus Vingis manufactures electronic components. The company's share capital now stands at 45.62 million litas.
